- A task's worktree now carries its unmerged dependencies' branches, so an agent builds on the work it was told to build on (#334)
- `dispatch.worktree_setup` runs your install command (e.g. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`) in each fresh worktree before the agent starts (#339)
- An agent that cannot report done exits cleanly instead of blocking finished work, and `orch doctor` warns when `.claude/settings.json` denies the done channel (#338)
- A task may make the edits it cannot work without (wiring, manifest and lockfile), and its PR lists every file outside the task's list (#340)
- `orch export clickup` mirrors the DAG into a ClickUp Folder (#316)
- New projects have `report_findings` on, asked in the wizard (#315)
- Fixes: an empty claude rule list no longer drops the worktree's allow-list (#317); velocity's window follows the backend clock (#332)
- Site: served from tryorch.us, with a working install command (#331, #333, #335)

## What's Changed
* feat(init): report_findings is on in a new project, asked in the wizard and announced in batch mode by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/315
* feat(export): orch export clickup — mirror the DAG into a ClickUp Folder by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/316
* fix(claude): an empty rule list no longer drops the worktree's allow-list by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/317
* feat(site): an install command that works, the operator's screen, and a way to follow the build by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/331
* fix(state): velocity's window follows the backend clock, not SQLite's by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/332
* feat(site): serve the page from tryorch.us by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/333
* fix(worktree): a task's worktree carries the branches of its unmerged dependencies by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/334
* feat(site): the build is followable on X too by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/335
* fix(prompt,doctor): an agent with no done channel exits cleanly instead of blocking by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/338
* feat(worktree): dispatch.worktree_setup prepares each fresh worktree before the agent starts by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/339
* fix(prompt,engine): a task may make the edits it cannot work without, and its PR names them by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/340


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0

- **Security: `orch dashboard --tunnel` now requires a token.** Before this release a tunnel published the whole operator dashboard with no login. Tunnels are Cloudflare quick tunnels only; the Tunnel page shows how to install `cloudflared` for your system.
- **Budget guardrail counts real usage and is on for new projects.** Claude cache tokens are counted (weighted by what they bill), `orch init` writes `budgets.yaml`, and Slack/Discord can warn you at 80% of a provider's window.
- **New operator dashboard.** "Now" shows which agents are working, what needs you and the budget window; four destinations instead of eleven pages; ⌘K palette; dark theme; Spanish and Portuguese; `orch dashboard --demo` to try it without a project.

### Upgrade notes (breaking)

- `tunnel.provider: autossh` / `bore` (and `command`/`args`/`url_regex`) now fail at load with the fix. Remove them and install `cloudflared`. A `tunnel:` block nested under `dashboard:` was always ignored; move it to the top level.
- `orch task set --milestone` is removed. Milestones are the project's phases everywhere; the MCP `orch_tasks` `milestone` filter takes a phase (`2`, `F2`, `Phase 2`).
- `budget.per_dispatch_usd` is passed to `claude --max-budget-usd` only when you write it in `config.yaml`.
- `dashboard.language` accepts `en`, `es`, `pt`; any other value now fails instead of falling back to Spanish. `summary_language` still works as an alias.
- Dashboard: `/` is now Now; the client summary moved to `/delivery/summary`. Old addresses redirect.
- Migration 007 adds cache-token columns to `spend`; migrations now run inside a transaction.

### Also new

- `orch report receipt` and a last-run receipt on Now (copy as Markdown); a first-run checklist built from `orch doctor`.
- `orch bench` runs one project with each provider and compares done tasks, time and spend (requires `--max-usd`; it dispatches real agents).
- Executive summary, client portal and PDF in Portuguese; blockers show what blocked the task.
- The dependency graph no longer bundles mermaid (-5.2 MB) and works offline.
- Site: a spec → DAG playground in the browser and a project template gallery.

### All changes

## What's Changed
* fix(dashboard): milestones are phases, Sprint is Pace, and the commands it names exist by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/297
* fix(budget): the guardrail counts real usage, is on for new projects, and the dashboard explains it by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/298
* feat(dashboard): orch dashboard --demo serves a synthetic project by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/296
* fix(dashboard): Cloudflare-only tunnel that requires a token, with guided install by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/300
* feat(web): dispatch-console design system for the operator dashboard (part 1) by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/299
* fix(budget): weight cache tokens in the window, and send --max-budget-usd only when per_dispatch_usd is written by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/301
* test(web): cover the dictionary, theme, status scale and Explain (follow-up to #299) by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/302
* chore(web): draw the dependency graph without mermaid (-5.2 MB) and lint web/ in CI by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/303
* feat(web): Milestones, Pace, Budget and Tunnel on the dispatch-console system (design system part 2) by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/304
* feat(i18n): Portuguese for everything a client reads, and blocker reasons that say what blocked the task by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/305
* test(web): Budget and Pace keep their labels and exclusions (follow-up to #304) by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/306
* feat(dashboard): Now as the first screen, and four destinations instead of eleven pages by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/307
* feat(notify): alert Slack/Discord before a provider hits its budget cap by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/308
* feat(site): spec playground in WebAssembly and a project template gallery by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/309
* feat(web): command palette (⌘K) and keyboard shortcuts for the operator dashboard by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/310
* feat(dashboard): the last run's receipt on Now, a first-run checklist, and orch report receipt by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/311
* feat(bench): orch bench compares providers on the same project by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/312
* feat(i18n): the operator dashboard in Spanish and Portuguese, with a language button by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/313
* fix(bench): one database connection per copy, and errors that say where they failed by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/314


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/compare/v0.14.0...v0.15.0

- New: `orch ci setup` reads your repository and writes the CI pipeline it calls for (lint, typecheck, tests, build per package), and can add an AI review of every pull request with Claude, Gemini, OpenAI or OpenRouter and the model you pick.
- New: a CI page in the operator dashboard shows how the pipeline is set up and where every pull request stands; the client portal shows how every delivery is checked.
- Task worktrees now live next to the project (`../<project>.worktrees/<task>`) instead of inside it, so pnpm and Node stop resolving the parent checkout.
- `orch run` warns and notifies when a run stalls, and a PR merged or closed by hand now finishes or blocks its task instead of being polled forever.
- Fixes: `router add-missing` writes real Claude model ids, `orch dashboard` says when a rotated token overrides `--token`, `orch init` no longer writes the removed `findings:` block, and the published portal renders when `index.html` is opened from disk.

### Upgrading

`orch upgrade` installs it (from v0.13.1 on, orch already told you about this release). Worktrees left inside `.worktrees/` by an older run still resolve and are listed by `orch doctor`; new ones go to the sibling directory, which must be writable.

## What's Changed
* feat(dashboard): a CI page for the operator, and tasks carry their PR and CI by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/281
* fix(scaffold): orch init no longer writes the removed findings block by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/282
* fix(dashboard): warn when a rotated database token overrides --token or dashboard.token by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/283
* fix(router): map claude model families to real cli_model ids and warn on unknown ones by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/284
* fix(engine): a merged or closed PR is final in the CI poller by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/285
* feat(ci): orch ci detect and orch ci setup propose the pipeline a repository calls for by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/286
* fix(engine): a stalled orch run warns and notifies once by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/287
* feat(providers): Result.Text carries the model's final answer by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/289
* fix(worktree): put task worktrees next to the project, not inside it by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/288
* feat(ci): orch ci review runs an AI review of a pull request inside CI by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/290
* fix(engine): read a PR's state only when CI cannot settle it, and announce a closed PR with its reason by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/291
* feat(portal): the client sees how every delivery is checked by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/292
* fix(publish): the exported portal renders when index.html is opened from disk by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/294
* feat(ci): orch ci setup adds an AI review of every pull request by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/295


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/compare/v0.13.1...v0.14.0

- A CI retry that pushes a fix to the same PR no longer ends `orch run`: it keeps its PR, waits on its CI again, and still counts toward `ci_max_retries` (#276).
- `orch run` picks up task statuses changed outside it (a task unblocked by hand, a failed bookkeeping write) instead of stalling or exiting with ready work (#255).
- Stakeholder sessions opened with v0.12 keep working in the client portal: it falls back to the token the browser saved (#274).
- New: orch tells you when a new release is out, with what it brings, and `orch upgrade` installs it (checksum-verified).

### Upgrading from v0.13.0 or earlier

This is the first release that can tell you about the next one, so upgrade by hand this once:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

From here on, orch shows new releases at the terminal (at most once a day; `ORCH_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` turns it off) and `orch upgrade` installs them.

## What's Changed
* fix(engine): a CI retry keeps its PR, and orch run adopts statuses changed outside it by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/277
* fix(web): the client portal falls back to the token this browser saved by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/278
* feat: orch says when a new release is out, and orch upgrade installs it by @hectorcanaimero in https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/pull/279

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hectorcanaimero/orch/compare/v0.13.0...v0.13.1
